item.title: v2.1.0 (macos)
item.description:
### Added - New Lancy logo: an "L" whose foot is a lance blade, with refreshed app icons, installer icons and website branding.
### Changed - Better small-window layout: pages no longer waste 48px on each side, so there is more room on narrow or split-screen windows. - Client and commission detail pages now wrap their totals and action buttons instead of running off the edge.
### Fixed - **Automatic updates now work.** The update feed is now signed (the app rejected unsigned feeds, so no update was ever offered), and the downloaded installer keeps its `.exe` name so the silent install actually runs. Versions 2.0.0 and 2.0.1 cannot update themselves: install 2.1.0 manually once from the download page, and later updates are automatic. - The updater now writes its progress to the app log, which makes "no update appeared" reports diagnosable.
